```{=html}
<style>
.planar-rotor-demo {
  width: min(610px, 100%);
  margin: 0.05rem auto 0;
  color: #f4f7fb;
  font-size: 0.72em;
}

.planar-rotor-frame {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(112, 190, 255, 0.38);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(36, 112, 171, 0.17), transparent 46%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #06111f 0%, #02070e 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}

.planar-rotor-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.planar-rotor-orbit {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(104, 190, 255, 0.7);
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-dasharray: 9 10;
}

.planar-rotor-axis {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.planar-rotor-angle {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #ffd166;
  stroke-width: 5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.planar-rotor-rod {
  stroke: #e9f4ff;
  stroke-width: 8;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.planar-rotor-velocity {
  stroke: #58d6c2;
  stroke-width: 6;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.planar-rotor-ball {
  fill: url(#planar-rotor-ball-gradient);
  stroke: #ffe5a2;
  stroke-width: 4;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 13px rgba(255, 171, 64, 0.72));
}

.planar-rotor-pivot-ring {
  fill: #06111f;
  stroke: #f4f7fb;
  stroke-width: 5;
}

.planar-rotor-pivot-dot {
  fill: #f4f7fb;
}

.planar-rotor-label {
  fill: #f4f7fb;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.planar-rotor-label-accent {
  fill: #ffd166;
  font-size: 30px;
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.planar-rotor-readout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem 0.45rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(112, 190, 255, 0.24);
  background: rgba(4, 13, 25, 0.9);
}

.planar-rotor-values {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  color: #dceafb;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.planar-rotor-values strong {
  color: #ffd166;
}

.planar-rotor-toggle {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(112, 190, 255, 0.62);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(18, 55, 88, 0.86);
  color: #f4f7fb;
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.planar-rotor-toggle:hover,
.planar-rotor-toggle:focus-visible {
  background: rgba(31, 91, 140, 0.94);
  outline: none;
}

.planar-rotor-caption {
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
  color: #b9c9d9;
  font-size: 0.84em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-align: center;
}
</style>

<div class="planar-rotor-demo" data-planar-rotor>
  <div class="planar-rotor-frame">
    <svg class="planar-rotor-svg" viewBox="0 0 620 520" role="img"
         aria-label="Шарик на жёстком стержне равномерно вращается вокруг неподвижной точки O">
      <defs>
        <radialGradient id="planar-rotor-ball-gradient" cx="34%" cy="28%" r="72%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff3be"/>
          <stop offset="38%" stop-color="#ffbe55"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ee7d22"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <marker id="planar-rotor-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5"
                markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#58d6c2"/>
        </marker>
      </defs>

      <line class="planar-rotor-axis" x1="75" y1="270" x2="565" y2="270"/>
      <circle class="planar-rotor-orbit" cx="310" cy="270" r="175"/>
      <path class="planar-rotor-angle" data-angle-arc d=""/>

      <g data-moving-arm>
        <line class="planar-rotor-rod" x1="310" y1="270" x2="485" y2="270"/>
        <circle class="planar-rotor-ball" cx="485" cy="270" r="27"/>
        <line class="planar-rotor-velocity" x1="485" y1="245" x2="485" y2="164"
              marker-end="url(#planar-rotor-arrow)"/>
      </g>

      <circle class="planar-rotor-pivot-ring" cx="310" cy="270" r="18"/>
      <circle class="planar-rotor-pivot-dot" cx="310" cy="270" r="6"/>

      <text class="planar-rotor-label" x="286" y="315">O</text>
      <text class="planar-rotor-label" data-radius-label x="396" y="294">R</text>
      <text class="planar-rotor-label" data-ball-label x="510" y="248">m</text>
      <text class="planar-rotor-label" data-velocity-label x="504" y="176">v</text>
      <text class="planar-rotor-label-accent" data-angle-label x="375" y="250">φ</text>
    </svg>

    <div class="planar-rotor-readout">
      <div class="planar-rotor-values">
        <span><strong data-angle-value>φ = 0.00</strong> рад</span>
        <span>R = const</span>
        <span>ω = const</span>
      </div>
      <button class="planar-rotor-toggle" type="button" data-toggle aria-pressed="false">Пауза</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="planar-rotor-caption">
    Стержень задаёт постоянный радиус; сила связи направлена к точке O и не создаёт момента относительно O.
  </p>

  <script>
  (() => {
    const root = document.currentScript.closest("[data-planar-rotor]");
    if (!root || root.dataset.initialized === "true") return;
    root.dataset.initialized = "true";

    const arm = root.querySelector("[data-moving-arm]");
    const arc = root.querySelector("[data-angle-arc]");
    const angleLabel = root.querySelector("[data-angle-label]");
    const radiusLabel = root.querySelector("[data-radius-label]");
    const ballLabel = root.querySelector("[data-ball-label]");
    const velocityLabel = root.querySelector("[data-velocity-label]");
    const value = root.querySelector("[data-angle-value]");
    const toggle = root.querySelector("[data-toggle]");

    const cx = 310;
    const cy = 270;
    const orbitRadius = 175;
    const arcRadius = 72;
    const turnMs = 4600;
    const holdMs = 900;
    const cycleMs = turnMs + holdMs;
    let paused = false;
    let pausedAngle = 0;
    let timeOrigin = performance.now();

    function point(radius, angle) {
      return {
        x: cx + radius * Math.cos(angle),
        y: cy - radius * Math.sin(angle)
      };
    }

    function render(angle) {
      const degrees = angle * 180 / Math.PI;
      arm.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${-degrees} ${cx} ${cy})`);

      const safeAngle = Math.min(angle, 2 * Math.PI - 0.001);
      if (safeAngle < 0.002) {
        arc.setAttribute("d", "");
      } else {
        const start = point(arcRadius, 0);
        const end = point(arcRadius, safeAngle);
        const large = safeAngle > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
        arc.setAttribute(
          "d",
          `M ${start.x} ${start.y} A ${arcRadius} ${arcRadius} 0 ${large} 0 ${end.x} ${end.y}`
        );
      }

      const labelPoint = point(arcRadius + 27, Math.max(0.22, safeAngle / 2));
      angleLabel.setAttribute("x", labelPoint.x - 8);
      angleLabel.setAttribute("y", labelPoint.y + 8);

      const radiusPoint = point(orbitRadius * 0.55, angle);
      radiusLabel.setAttribute("x", radiusPoint.x + 16 * Math.sin(angle) - 8);
      radiusLabel.setAttribute("y", radiusPoint.y + 16 * Math.cos(angle) + 8);

      const ballPoint = point(orbitRadius, angle);
      ballLabel.setAttribute("x", ballPoint.x + 23);
      ballLabel.setAttribute("y", ballPoint.y - 18);

      const velocityPoint = point(orbitRadius + 42, angle + 0.25);
      velocityLabel.setAttribute("x", velocityPoint.x);
      velocityLabel.setAttribute("y", velocityPoint.y);

      value.textContent = `φ = ${angle.toFixed(2)}`;
    }

    function frame(now) {
      if (!paused) {
        const phase = (now - timeOrigin) % cycleMs;
        const angle = phase < turnMs ? 2 * Math.PI * phase / turnMs : 2 * Math.PI;
        pausedAngle = angle;
        render(angle);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      paused = !paused;
      toggle.textContent = paused ? "Продолжить" : "Пауза";
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(paused));
      if (!paused) {
        const phase = Math.min(pausedAngle / (2 * Math.PI), 1) * turnMs;
        timeOrigin = performance.now() - phase;
      }
    });

    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      paused = true;
      pausedAngle = Math.PI / 3;
      render(pausedAngle);
      toggle.textContent = "Запустить";
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    } else {
      render(0);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  })();
  </script>
</div>
```
